name: hint.confirm
title: Confirm hints
summary: Confirm hints, by ID (hintIds) or all of one element (ref, target): writes the current target version into the relation or inline reference (in the text or in a property marked `markdown`, SR-127; `relation.outdated`) or into the `replaces` item (`variant.core-changed`, SR-045), and nothing else but the current titles of the file's same-repository targets (D-042); an ID no open hint has gives a warning, for example one confirmed already.
whileReadOnlyReason: Writes the current version of the target, which depends on the metamodel (which properties count).

input.description: Give `hintIds`, `ref`, `target` or several of them; none is `input.invalid`. `ref` and `target` select the open confirmable hints (those with a `hintId`, as hint.list gives them) about `ref` and pointing at `target`, both when both are given; `kind` narrows only that selection and needs `ref` or `target`. The selected hints and `hintIds` are confirmed together, as one set (SR-027 AK2): each once, `confirmed` names `hintIds` first, then the selected IDs. A selection without an open confirmable hint is a `hint.not-found` warning, left out when the call already gives `hint.not-confirmable` for the since-baseline hints (SR-103 AK5).

hintIds.description: IDs of hints to confirm (`hintId` of hint.list).

ref.description: Confirm the open confirmable hints about this element: the outdated relations and inline references (in the text and in properties marked `markdown`) its file stores, and its `replaces` items onto a changed core requirement. A variant with open `variant.core-changed-since-baseline` or `variant.core-new-since-baseline` hints, without `kind`, gives `hint.not-confirmable` for them, since a new baseline of the variant settles them (SR-103 AK5).

target.description: Confirm the open confirmable hints on relations and inline references that point at this element, for example after it changed.

kind.description: Only selected hints with one of these codes (with `ref` or `target`); the confirmable codes are `relation.outdated` and `variant.core-changed`; `variant.core-changed-since-baseline` and `variant.core-new-since-baseline` give `hint.not-confirmable`, since a new baseline of the variant settles them (SR-103 AK5).
